​What is PipesHub

PipesHub is an open-source context layer for AI agents and an enterprise search platform.Company knowledge is spread across Slack, Google Drive, Jira, Confluence, GitHub, Microsoft 365 and dozens of other apps. PipesHub connects to them and indexes their content into a knowledge graph and a search index. Where an app records who can see what, as Slack, Google Drive, Jira, Confluence, GitHub and Microsoft 365 do, PipesHub follows those permissions.
